after_expected_public_metadata.description:
UNCERTIFIED — no hash-bound Viridis Comparator certificate covers this deposit's claims. Lean sources may compile but have not been independently certified. Results are conditional on the stated model assumptions.

Historical description:

Series S2 (Monitoring & Certification) of the Viridis Canon. The core Intelligence-Bound canon spine is unchanged (frozen at v10.1.0 “The Keystone Wave”, record 21223021); this record links to the spine via isDerivedFrom the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982, and references the S2 series anchor, the Monitoring Water-Filling Theorem (record 20704853).

A re-verification certificate is a decaying asset: a site last observed at time zero drifts under Ornstein–Uhlenbeck dynamics, and the steward's confidence in its current state decays accordingly. The Stewardship Revisit Theorem (SRT), “the Tender,” asks: at what cadence should a site be re-observed? We prove the answer is a square-root law — the classic economic-order-quantity form τ* = √(2c/(κs²)) — that tightens where drift is fast and relaxes where it is slow, replacing fiat re-verification intervals with an auditable thermodynamic law, and that this cadence is Whittle-indexable, so a portfolio of drifting sites can be prioritized by a single broadcast clock price.

Eight results are machine-checked in Lean 4 (Aristotle, zero sorry, axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}), namespace Viridis.Monitoring.StewardshipRevisit, covering: the OU half-life identity; strict monotone variance growth; the square-root optimal cadence and its minimized cost; the Whittle-index form of the re-observation problem; existence and uniqueness of a single broadcast clock price equalizing marginal penalty across a portfolio; and a concrete non-vacuous witness.

SRT completes a space-time monitoring trilogy under the Intelligence Bound: the D-Score Measurement Closure Theorem (how much to monitor one site), the Monitoring Water-Filling Theorem (where to spend a fixed budget across sites), and SRT itself (when to re-observe a drifting site). The single-site Wu-Wei Sampling Theorem is recovered as SRT's threshold limit. This is the 29th Intelligence-Bound self-application.

Scope. The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
after_expected_public_metadata.notes: Viridis Canon, Series S2 (Monitoring & Certification) member. Routed from Nightly Run-087 (2026-07-02); ledger row 43. 29th Intelligence-Bound self-application. Completes the space-time monitoring trilogy: DMCT (how much to monitor one site, in spine v6) x MWT (where to spend a fixed budget, S2-v1 20704853) x SRT (when to re-observe drifting sites). Spine unchanged (frozen at v10.1.0, record 21223021); this record links to the spine via isDerivedFrom the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982 and references both the S2 series anchor (MWT, 20704853) and the current spine head. Lean 4 proofs (Aristotle project cabf29e2-0bcb-4dd2-92ef-50512ef3606f, task 1a0209de-b9dd-4266-9642-3e35f50b3f59, COMPLETE @100%, ~22 min, toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, Mathlib pin 8f9d9cff) certify the analytic core of SRT, namespace Viridis.Monitoring.StewardshipRevisit. The eight verified theorems, statements verbatim: (1) certificate_halflife_eq_ln2_over_2theta -- at t_half = ln2/2theta the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck conditional variance equals half its asymptotic value; (2) ou_conditional_variance_growth_monotone -- the conditional variance V(t) is strictly increasing in the age of the last observation; (3) ou_variance_pos_of_pos_age -- V(t) is strictly positive for positive age (auxiliary); (4) sqrt_cadence_minimizes_amortized_cost -- the cadence tau* = sqrt(2c/(kappa s^2)) globally minimizes the amortized cost C(tau) = c/tau + (1/2) kappa s^2 tau, an EOQ / AM-GM square-root law; (5) sqrt_cadence_optimal_value -- the minimized cost equals sqrt(2 c kappa s^2); (6) whittle_index_form_eq_stakes_times_variance_rate -- the Whittle index W(t) = kappa * V(t) is strictly increasing in age, hence indexable, under the corrected-index convention (rate = kappa*V, not kappa*dV/dt); (7) broadcast_clock_price_equalizes_marginal_penalty -- existence and uniqueness of the positive service time (the temporal water level) that equalizes marginal re-verification penalty across sites; (8) srt_nonvacuous -- an explicit concrete binding witness (theta=s=kappa=1, c=1, nu=1/4). All conclusions non-vacuous. The single-site Wu-Wei Sampling Theorem (Run-078) is recovered as SRT's threshold limit. The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
